## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in San Miguel De Abona, Spain. It starts at Avda. Siam Park, s/n.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Enjoy a two-for-one adrenaline-packed adventure, with this special ticket to Tenerife's wildest attractions. Get back to nature amid thousands of exotic animals at the famous Loro Parque zoo, then go wild at one of the world's greatest waterparks – the awe-inspiring Siam Park.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €83.57. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 260 ratings and 77 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
